item.title: Saddlers Support Amelia at Tomorrow’s Match Against Barnet
item.description: At tomorrow’s match against Barnet, we will be coming together to support a young girl from the West Midlands to help make her upcoming birthday extra special. Seven-year-old Amelia Kolpa, from Rowley Regis, has been bravely battling stage-4 neuroblastoma since a young age. As she approaches her eighth birthday, Amelia shared a simple but powerful wish - to receive as many birthday cards as possible.
